$schema_note: Deadline-time source coverage audit; no model-accuracy claim.
selection_rule: latest GitHub commit touching snapshot_file at or before each inferred deadline
deadline_method: earliest GW kickoff minus 90 minutes (inferred, not archived)
conclusion: The repository history can provide causal availability snapshots, but not a full-season exact Benchwarmers benchmark. Only 13 deadlines have a snapshot no older than 14 days, historical Understat snapshots are absent, stable previous-season identity covers 63.5% of target players, and prior-season DefCon inputs do not exist.
limitations: Commit time proves the snapshot existed by the cutoff, not that it was captured exactly at the FPL deadline.
A stale snapshot is causal but may omit recent availability and injury changes.
Deadlines are inferred rather than archived official values.
Final fixture assignments can differ from what was known at the historical deadline.
Vaastav expected-stat fields are not a drop-in replacement for the workbook's Understat inputs.
